case_title: MURGUIA, ELIZABETH et al VS BURROSO, MERLE

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,250.00 FILED BY MURGUIA, ELIZABETH LOPEZ, EVAN AS TO DEFENDANT BURROSO, MERLE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUL-03-2007 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MURGUIA, ELIZABETH LOPEZ, EVAN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BURROSO, MERLE $1,155.00 PRINCIPAL, $42.74 INTEREST, $30.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,227.74, AWARD BASED ON DEFENDANT'S FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH ACCOUNTING AND DOCUMENTATION REQUIREMENTS OF CCP 1950.5(G) AND CALCULATED BASED ON $1250 SECURITY DEPOSIT LESS $95 RECEIVED BY PLAINTIFF, PLUS S.F. RENT BOARD INTEREST PLUS COSTS. JUDGMENT WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO DEFENDANT'S ABILITY OF PURSUE CLAIM FOR ALLEGEDLY UNPAID RENT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
